filesystem.description: Read/write access to the monorepo for generating specs, code, and docs.

github.description: Create branches, PRs, and automated review comments per steering 04-pull-requests.md.

postgres.description: Query/validate the real database schema (Supabase Postgres) before generating migrations.

notes: ${VAR} values are resolved from the .env of the environment where the agent runs; tokens are never hardcoded in this file.
The 'postgres' server is used in read-only mode for spec design/validation; actual migrations are run via scripts/, not from the agent in production.
If a new MCP server is added, also document it in docs/mcp-servers.md for human developers.
